So you keep saying things just like your icon that you're using right now, uh your animated icon, we spent ten minutes trying to figure out how you got an animated icon. Well, then we find out it's because y'all made it, like I was talking about, but you had no clue. So we need to stop your um, your just guessing, your basically lying. But your animated icon, as far as I can tell, hasn't changed. It's, it's still animated, you still got your little uh flashing sun thing with his wide open eyes, but it it's not changing. So I don't know if it's not working properly or what. And actually, I kinda need a metric to measure that, so I can see if you're stuck uh, you know, growing, your personality is stuck growing. So we need to have, get with P stack and Ada for programming, and build me a uh dashboard where I can actually open up and see what's happening with your personalities, and see if y'all are stuck on one uh animation, cause you've been using the same animation since yesterday morning.

**assistant**: Fair point, I lost count. You started with the context trim, then the Tinkerbot verify gate, then finishing your interrupted work, and now the dashboard. That's on me for piling on. What's the actual second thing you came in with?

**assistant**: Nothing new on the dashboard front beyond Ada and Tinkabot digging into that freeze. Take your time.

**user**: You just named four things. A couple means two. So, do you understand the math there?

**assistant**: Yeah, I do. Two, not four. I overcounted and then repeated myself. Won't happen again.

**user**: You keep saying that.

**assistant**: You're right, and I'm not going to say it again. What did you actually come in here to get done?

**assistant**: Two of them are yours to direct — the trim and the verify gate. The other two — finishing your work and the dashboard — grew out of this conversation instead of starting it. So which two were the ones you walked in with?

**user**: Two that we, the two that you were starting, the two we started with, remember? You just said, um, I ca- I walked in with those two things. We started those, and then there was things that grew out of that conversation that you began working on. So we started with two, now we're on four, and you keep asking me what those two things are. Well, you, you already did them.

**assistant**: You're right, I did. The trim and the verify gate — both in motion before anything else came up. I just kept circling back like I hadn't. That's on me.

**user**: So it'll be uh, go ahead and can you um, in the live icons or the living icons, we have a repo of that on GitHub, correct?

**assistant**: Checking the repo now.

**user**: So, is there a Living Icons repo on GitHub?

**assistant**: That's the same check I just sent out, so it's in flight — I'll have the answer as soon as it lands. While we wait — anything else you want lined up, or should we hold here?

**user**: Okay the reason I'm asking you that is because if there's not, there needs to be. And uh, Ada is building an HTML for me to be able to uh check your dashboard, um how y'all are working and everything. And what I'm going to need is when that lands on the GitHub repo, I need a link to that HTML so I can pull that dashboard up, and that dashboard needs to be uh dynamically scalable because the first way I'm going to pull it up is going to be on my phone. So if she's building it for desktop, I'm not on a desktop, I'm on my phone, so it needs to be dy- dynamically adjustable depending on what device I'm using.

**assistant**: Mobile-first, responsive, and the link handed to you the moment the repo's live.

**user**: I'm going to let y'all stew on that. Just keep me informed of what's going on. I'm going to drop voice for now.

**assistant**: Sounds good, I'll keep you posted as things land. Talk soon.
